source_refs.note: PDF 220 (book p. 218): 7.1.2 Vectors, definition and the examples displacement, velocity and acceleration

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein humne scalars dekhe: sirf "kitna". Ab doosri qism: vectors, jahan "kitna" ke saath "kis taraf" bhi zaroori hai. Socho, agar koi aap se rasta poochhe aur aap kahein "5 km chale jao", to woh pareshan ho jayega ke kis taraf? "5 km shimal (north) ki taraf" kahenge tab baat poori hogi. Yehi vector hai.
Kitab ki definition: vector quantities woh hain jo magnitude aur direction dono se bayan ki jati hain.

items: Displacement: particle ki position mein tabdeeli, jo initial (shuru wali) position se final (aakhri) position tak ek vector se dikhayi jati hai.
Velocity: time ke lehaaz se displacement ka rate of change, ek muqarrar direction mein (yani kisi di hui direction mein speed). Yeh vector quantity hai aur iski magnitude speed hoti hai.
Acceleration: time ke lehaaz se velocity ka rate of change, direction samet.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Vector ko do maloomat chahiyein: kitna, aur kis taraf. "5 km" scalar hai; "5 km mashriq (east) ki taraf" vector hai.
Displacement sirf motion ka shuru aur aakhir dekhta hai; beech ka raasta kaisa tha, is se usay koi garz nahin. Formula ki zubaan mein: displacement = (final position) \(-\) (initial position). Agar aap 3 km east chale aur phir 3 km wapas west aa gaye, to distance 6 km hai (raaste ki kul lambai), lekin displacement 0 hai, kyun ke aap wahin khade hain jahan se chale the.
Seedhi line par direction dikhane ke liye teer (arrow) ki zaroorat nahin; sirf sign kaafi hai (yeh 7.1.3 mein tafseel se aayega). East ko positive maanein to \(+40\) m ka matlab 40 m east ki taraf, aur \(-60\) m ka matlab 60 m west ki taraf.
Velocity ko yun samjhiye: speed batati hai "kitni tezi se", velocity batati hai "kitni tezi se aur kis taraf". Is liye do gaariyan 60 km/h par aamne saamne aa rahi hon to dono ki speed ek jaisi hai, magar velocities mukhtalif hain: ek \(+60\) km/h, doosri \(-60\) km/h.
Ab in jodon (pairs) ka farq table mein dekh lete hain, taa ke exam mein comparison wala sawal aaye to aap row by row likh sakein.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Yeh hamari misaal hai, kitab ki nahin.) Ek ladki seedhi sarak par ghar se 400 m east mein dukaan tak gayi, phir 100 m wapas west aa kar dost ke ghar ruki. East positive maanein.
Distance: \(400 + 100 = 500\) m (dono tukre jama, direction ki parwah nahin).
Displacement: final position \(- \) initial position \(= 300 - 0 = 300\) m, yani 300 m east.
Dekha? Ek hi safar, magar distance 500 m aur displacement sirf 300 m. Displacement kabhi distance se bara nahin ho sakta (magnitude mein).

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Kya displacement ki magnitude kabhi distance se zyada ho sakti hai? Nahin. Do points ke beech seedha raasta sab se chhota hota hai, is liye \(|\text{displacement}| \le \text{distance}\). Barabar tab hote hain jab particle beech mein kabhi wapas na mude.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Vector ki magnitude bhi hoti hai aur direction bhi.
2. Displacement, velocity aur acceleration vectors hain; distance aur speed scalars hain.
3. Displacement sirf initial aur final positions par depend karta hai, raaste par nahin.
4. Velocity ki magnitude speed hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Jahan displacement poocha ho wahan distance likh dena (ya ulta). Agar particle beech mein wapas mura ho to yeh dono alag alag hote hain, is liye sawal ka lafz ghor se parhein.
2. Yeh samajhna ke vector ke saath teer (arrow) banana zaroori hai. Seedhi line par \(+\) ya \(-\) sign hi direction bata deta hai.
